collection.retry_policy: Same payload/seed after unrecoverable transport interruption; no completed-answer resampling.

deployment.seed_policy: Fresh independent integer for each slot, saved in request; same seed for its transport retries

rating_methods: Two human reviewers reviewed responses and finalized ratings; one distinct final set retained. AI-proposed annotations were available to accept or correct. No independent-agreement estimate.
reviewer_credit: Two independent human raters with data annotation experience
